experiment_template.research_question: Does preserving the most comprehensive observed span per recent path prevent newest-handle context loss within the same state-slot budget?
stop_conditions: Every Round 25 identity runs once; failures remain in the denominator.
No task, threshold, scorer, order, context/output/total-token cap, or within-round state-policy change after freeze.

records.falsifier: Any handle is unbound, selection is nondeterministic, a path appears twice, the full denominator is missing, scheduled span gain is below +0.05, file or valid completion degrades, unknown usage appears, or treatment cumulative model tokens exceed control.
records.mechanism: Select the eight newest distinct paths. Within each path choose the delivered observation with the greatest inclusive line span, break equal-width ties by newest receipt, restore chronological output order, and expose one observed-not-relevant recovery handle per path.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: For each of the eight newest observed paths, retaining the widest delivered receipt-bound span rather than the newest handle preserves more recoverable implementation context and improves GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench quality and completion without increasing cumulative model tokens.

stop_conditions: Do not infer semantic relevance or tune within the round.

records.falsifier: Mixed horizons increase stale anchoring, lose recent evidence, increase tokens, or miss a fixed quality, validity, or integrity gate.
records.mechanism: Reserve deterministic slots for earliest distinct paths and fill the remainder with newest distinct paths, one receipt-bound handle per path.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A mixed-horizon projection retaining early discovery paths and recent working paths prevents discovery loss better than newest-only path selection.

stop_conditions: Do not infer relevance or add unobserved facts.

records.falsifier: Required handles disappear, native quality or validity degrades, or treatment model tokens do not become non-increasing.
records.mechanism: At each recycle boundary, project only evidence not shown in an earlier generation, bounded by the same path and token caps.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Presenting only newly observed receipt-bound handles once reduces repeated state tokens and stale anchoring while retaining enough recovery continuity.

stop_conditions: Do not lower thresholds or select favorable repetitions.

records.falsifier: A frozen full-denominator development round and untouched confirmation both meet every fixed quality, validity, integrity, and token criterion.
records.mechanism: The model already retains or reconstructs enough evidence; repeated handle metadata changes stochastic search more than it helps continuity.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Deterministic evidence-handle projection has no stable positive causal effect on GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench quality at 8K within non-increasing model tokens.

selection.reason: Round 24 directly measured same-path replacement loss: 82/183 projected slots chose narrower handles, retaining only 62.8% of the available widest-span lines.
